info.title: Podcast player API
info.description: Owner API for a personal podcast player with one-tap snips. All /v1 routes except POST /v1/devices and GET /v1/health need `Authorization: Bearer <device token>` (or the web cookie). Times are integer milliseconds relative to one audio asset. See docs/core in the repository for the data model and function contracts.
